records.title: Establishing a Fixed Time Period of Admission and an Extension of Stay Procedure for Nonimmigrant Academic Students, Exchange Visitors, and Representatives of Foreign Information Media
records.abstract: DHS proposed changing F, J, and I classifications from duration of status to admission for a fixed time period.

records.title: Establishing a Fixed Time Period of Admission and an Extension of Stay Procedure for Nonimmigrant Academic Students, Exchange Visitors, and Representatives of Foreign Information Media
records.abstract: DHS amended its regulations to change the admission period in the F, J, and I classifications from duration of status to a fixed time period and added extension requirements.

records.title: Optional Practical Training Fees
records.abstract: This proposed rule would introduce fees for F-1 nonimmigrant students seeking initial or subsequent Optional Practical Training through a certified institution.

records.title: Employment Authorization for Lebanese F-1 Nonimmigrant Students Experiencing Severe Economic Hardship as a Direct Result of the Current Crisis in Lebanon
records.abstract: DHS suspended certain requirements for eligible Lebanese F-1 students so they could request employment authorization, work additional hours, or reduce course load while maintaining status.
